name: hidden-field-guard
title: Hidden Field Guard
description: Banner for a hidden conditional section that names the fields still holding values and says whether they will be submitted or dropped, with Keep, Clear (through real input events so React state follows) and Undo.

meta.stops: Hidden field still submitted old value
meta.summary: When a conditional form section is hidden, it names the fields still filled in there, so old values don't ride along unseen.
catches: Values left in a section the user has hidden
Whether those values will still be submitted
Clearing that bypasses React state: it fires real input events instead
limits: Only sees native inputs inside the section's DOM; custom widgets that keep values elsewhere are missed
Submitted vs dropped depends on the hiddenValues/submitted setting you pass, not on inspecting your submit code
a11y: Banner is a labelled region inside a polite live region
Field names come from the field's label, aria-label, placeholder or name
Keep, Clear and Undo are buttons; icons are aria-hidden
